title: fix(cop): key the COP duty floor on the modulation floor; publish the refusal; persist the last measured COP
body:
A live v6.7.17 install never produced a COP sample. It has a 14 kW nameplate maximum, and its pump draws 1.9-2.55 kW. The duty floor was `max(0.3 x max_electrical_power, 0.2)` = 4.2 kW, above every draw, so the observed-COP sensor stayed unavailable and the flow-lift fold was starved too. All numbers below are synthetic. Rounds 10 and 11 re-cut the headings, the arms that fire and every main-dependent figure (past three rounds, re-cut rather than repair); round 12 is the next conflict's resolution: the merge of live `origin/main 8b495603a` — which is #2119's own merge commit, the money-and-memory lane this branch's blocks now sit beside — one content conflict, resolved semantic (union). See the round-12 bullets and `## Head`.

**What round 12 adds** -- the merge of `origin/main 8b495603a` and its one conflict, resolved:

- **`tests/features.py`, one conflict: an add/add of two blocks at the same spot, resolved as a union, not a pick.** This branch's COP duty-floor block (`R.section("COP learner duty floor keys on the modulation floor (live v6.7.17)")`) and main's #2119 R9-UX-6 money-and-memory block (`R9-UX-6: money and memory -- the receipt, the capacity line, the replay`) both appended after the same `sw4` checks; the resolver kept both, in branch-then-main order. The proof is the property, not the instance: comparing the `R.check` name sets of `origin/main:tests/features.py` and the merged tree, **main names lost by the resolution: 0; names main does not hold: 23** -- exactly this branch's COP checks, the block the conflict hunk's ours side carried. The behaviour half: `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/features.py` at the new head prints **`ALL 4107 FEATURE CHECKS PASSED`** -- the union is green against main's newer blocks, the macOS BLAS float arm included this time.
- **`tests/closures.json` and `tests/structure_budgets.json` came through the tree's `ledgermerge` driver** (`LEDGER-MERGE: resolved ...`, the budget with `max_class_loc: 8788 + both deltas = 8705`, and its own instruction to re-run the gate that owns the file). The gate confirms the driver's arithmetic is the tree's own measurement: `python3 tests/structure.py` measures `max_class_loc` at **exactly 8705**, `seam_cut_total` at 752 (main's 754, paid by the merge), and `--record` re-took `recorded_at` at `8b495603a`. Every budget cell is at or below main's own value; nothing is raised over main and no raise was sought.
- **Every other auto-merge was clean.** The production merge hunks in `accuracy.py` are confined to the imports and the `AccuracyTracker` region (diff hunks end at line ~530); `MeasuredCop` begins at line 793, so the class this fix owns is **byte-identical, line-shifted only**, and `draw_range.py` is untouched by the merge (`git diff 357e058ea HEAD -- custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/draw_range.py` is empty). The mutation proof and the acceptance rows are re-stated, not re-driven, on that byte-identity; the COP harness re-run confirms it below.
- **The silent-revert sweep** over the 7 files both sides touched since `595c23b5` (the branch's previous main): every line `git diff 595c23b5..8b495603a` adds was checked for verbatim survival in the merged tree -- **0 lost**, except the budget cells above, which the driver and the `--record` re-take own. No production, closure or ledger line is lost; #2119's landed lines all survive.
- The production delta re-measured at this head: **239 added / 53 removed over six files** (`git diff origin/main HEAD -- custom_components/`: `accuracy.py`, `coordinator.py`, `diagnostics.py`, `draw_range.py`, `store.py`, `thermal_model.py`). Both claim files remain byte-identical to main (same `shasum -a 1` at head and main; `git diff --name-only origin/main HEAD -- tests/golden/` is empty), so this branch claims nothing and both files are main's own bytes.

## Head

`2f393446869852376694099d960cb4779ed52f3c` (round 12), whose parents are `357e058ea` -- round 11's head, itself the merge of live `origin/main d214c53a2` -- and `8b495603a`, live `origin/main` at merge time. `git merge-base origin/main HEAD` = `8b495603a` (main is an ancestor of the head), so the App push is a fast-forward and every three-dot comparison below is against main's tip. `git status --porcelain` is empty at the head and after every instrument run below.

Production identity: the merge moved no line of the fix's own -- `MeasuredCop` and `draw_range.py` byte-identical to `357e058ea` -- and the branch's production delta over main is 239 added / 53 removed over six files, the same figure round 10 measured. That is why the mutation proof and the acceptance rows are re-stated rather than re-driven.

Round 11's head, for the record: `a628f17415e9f34b57ff067f5f5077ce220bd933` -- the merge of `origin/main d214c53a2` into round 10's `8af5e1d3a`, whose single conflict (`tests/deployment_shape.py`) was resolved with main's side taken whole. Round 10's head was `8af5e1d3a`; its derivation is in the round-10 body and is not repeated here.

## Mutation proof

Each mutant is applied to a copy in its own worktree, mutating `MeasuredCop.judge_ratio` and its return arms; all three lines are byte-identical at this head (`## Head`). Round 3 measured them against the harness, the `features.py` block this branch carries, and the probe rows; they are carried, because the files they mutate are byte-identical at every head this body names.

- M11, the no-evidence branch made to fold always: `with no draw evidence a departure folds only past the nameplate third: it waits for evidence on 14 kW and folds on 4 kW, as base` and the off-ask check fail. Harness `selfset_hourly` drops to 0.719.
- M12, the no-evidence branch made to refuse always: the same no-evidence check fails. Probe 7's `narrow_config_true0.75` reads 0/400 at 1.000 -- round 3's deadlock.
- M13, evidence that the draw does not follow made to fold: `a draw that ignores the ask (varying or flat) is refused as off-ask; a matched draw and a 0.7 shift on a draw that follows its ask still teach` fails. Harness `selfmod_independent_4kw` drops to 0.565.
- M6, M7, M9, M10 (round 3) and M1-M5, M8 (round 2) were not re-run; their lines are unchanged.

Round 6's **condition-level measure** stands as the method, because the driver the pins are recorded against still cannot complete on this host (`## Friction`). For each site the pass left, the fixer copied the package, rewrote that one line to the operator's own `new` text, and re-evaluated the condition of the `R.check` that names it. Five sites showed **no** condition changed and are the five `survivor_triage` rows -- the null control on the method.

## Null control

#2065's head is the null for every harness and probe row. The matched-draw control is 96/96 at 1.000 (harness) and 400/400 at 1.000 (probe 6). For the condition measure the null is the tree itself: all 18 conditions read `True` at the head, and it returned no difference at all on the five sites that ended in `survivor_triage`. The local full drive is still unavailable (the box bound below); CI's Linux matrix is the authority on mutant outcomes; what was verified here is the refusal, which is computed before any drive.

## Figures

Each line is the command that printed it, run at `2f3934468` against live `origin/main` `8b495603a` unless it names another tree. CI's check-runs at the pushed head are the authority for anything this host cannot produce.

- `python3 tests/structure.py` -- `STRUCTURE RATCHET PASSED`, every cell `ok`; `max_class_loc` measures **exactly** the ledgermerge driver's 8705, `seam_cut_total` 752 <= 752, `recorded_at` re-taken at `8b495603a` with `--record` on the clean tree. `git diff origin/main HEAD -- tests/structure_budgets.json` is `recorded_at` + the two paid cells (`max_class_loc` 8715 -> 8705, `seam_cut_total` 754 -> 752); nothing moved up.
- `D=$(mktemp -d); python3 tests/closure.py select --diff 8b495603a --workdir "$D"` -- `MODE: SCOPED -- 28 script(s) run, 5 scoped out.` (keyed on the mode line, never the count), over the 69 changed files.
- `python3 tests/closure.py selftest` -- `ALL 101 closure shrink pins PASSED`.
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/features.py` -- **`ALL 4107 FEATURE CHECKS PASSED`**, the union proof's behaviour half, macOS BLAS float arm included.
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/entities.py` -- `ALL 2286 ENTITY CHECKS PASSED`.
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/env_drift.py --all 8b495603a` -- `NO UNCLAIMED DRIFT: 56 scenario(s) checked against 8b495603a136...`; `NO STALE FIXTURE: 56 committed fixture(s) still match what this tree computes`. The fix's own behaviour is in the COP learner's judged samples, not the captured payload, so the merge adds no capture drift and the claim files stay main's own bytes.
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/deployment_shape.py` -- `ALL DEPLOYMENT SHAPE CHECKS PASSED` (main's census docstring is this branch's bytes and true on the merged tree).
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/guard_pins.py` -- `ALL 50 GUARD PIN CHECKS PASSED`.
- `python3 tests/layout.py` -- `layout self-test: ok`, rc=0.
- `node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs` -- rc=0; `dev/programme/carries/carry-2065.json` and `carry-2066.json` (both re-keyed by the merge's clean auto-merge, still in the diff) each read 0 errors / 0 warnings.
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round4/D6/claims.py` -- `claims_extracted=125 claims_checked=125 claims_true=123 claims_false=0 claims_stale=0 claims_unverifiable=2 arch_modules_on_disk=76 arch_map_listed=76 arch_map_missing=0`; `git status --porcelain` empty after.
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub:custom_components:tests python3 dev/audit/harnesses/cop_duty_floor.py` -- 31 `RESULT` lines, rc=0; the RESULT-line sha1 is `4aa477fcefe6696a305ac34d87d50362d5296b3d`, which the byte-identity of the two files it drives predicts.
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/finite_boundary.py` -- `ALL 84 FINITE BOUNDARY CHECKS PASSED` (the file is in this diff).
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/harness_headers.py` -- `ALL 109 HARNESS HEADER CHECKS PASSED`.
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tests/typing_ruler.py` -- `ALL 11 typing-ruler source checks PASSED`; the mypy census itself is CI's `typing` job.
- `PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tools/pr/ci_predict.py --base origin/main` -- `CI PREDICT: no closures or fast red predicted against 8b495603a136 (a data-file read is not seen)`; no unpinned-site warning line, so prepr step 6d lists nothing and step 7d has nothing to demand.
- Left to CI (heavy, per tvofi's 2026-10-07 rule): `fast`'s full matrix, the mutation drive, `slow`, `stress`, `optimality`, `golden`, the card lanes and the nightly set. The local drives' box bounds are recorded in `## Friction`.

## Red checks

Carried from round 11 and re-answered at the new head; the arms this merge touched are re-measured above.

- **`mutation`** -- the range's reds all fired on sites the diff added undispositioned; `added_unpinned` is 0 and `ratchet_refusal None` (round 11's re-derive, carried on the byte-identity of the files it measured), `ci_predict` prints no unpinned warning at this head, and the eleven ledger rows of the round-9 debt are on main. Whether the job is green at this head is CI's to report -- on this box neither drive completes (`## Friction`).
  - Cheaper detector and its standing cost: `tools/pr/ci_predict.py` (static, seconds; prepr step 6d) plus the re-derive probe's `added`/`ratchet_refusal` lines.
- **`fast (3.14)`** -- three reds in the range, all this branch's round-4 pair-cause commits: two stale `killed_by` pins and #2065's retired harness path in `tests/layout.py`; both classes measured closed (`ledger_form_problems`/`layout_problems`/`triage_problems`/`completeness_problems` all `[]`, `tests/layout.py` exits 0). Two further `fast` defects on this range are main-data defects fixed by #2173 and #2179, not this diff. The `features.py` arm that stopped the local drive passed here (`ALL 4107`), so the union added no red.
- **`nightly-ha (stable)` / `nightly-ha (2025.2.0)`** -- infrastructure (`Pull the Home Assistant image` failed at the bot pin head) and the `hb:positive_control` flake, with main's own live flake history; `defect-root-cause.md`'s grades-outside-this-diff exemption applies to the py-spy positive control (#1758).
- **`briefs`** -- this branch's round-4 debt, measured closed: `node tools/policy/brief_lint.mjs` exits 0 at this head, 0 errors / 0 warnings on both carry files.
- **`nightly-status`** -- reports main's last scheduled run, not this diff; the grades-outside-this-diff exemption stands.
- **`pr-contract`, `policy-docs`, `env-matrix`, `budget-raise-gate`, `wave-script`** -- green wherever they have run. At this head `budget-raise-gate` has nothing to gate: no `*_budgets.json` cell in this diff exceeds main's own value.

## Unpinned sites

`none`. `added by this diff 0` (round 11's re-derive, carried on byte-identity), independently by `ci_predict` (no warning line at this head), and by the pin-shard arithmetic: every digest of the round-9 debt is a `killed_by` row on main, and this branch's ledger delta over main is its own `MeasuredCop`/`_fold_measured_cop` rows, byte-identical to round 11's. The residual pass pool (the `6deb0603` survivor pair at `coordinator.py`'s `_fold_measured_cop`, main's line re-anchored by this PR's rename) is in the pool and not charged by the ratchet; a measured survivor owes a human disposition, never a bot one (`ci-autofix.md`), and `## Forward-carry` says where it goes.

## Forward-carry

- `dev/programme/carries/carry-2066.json`: to fix 3 (live learners), hold-then-replay. A departure seen before the evidence exists is held, then folded or dropped once `follows_ask` decides. Control: probe 6 `selfset_hourly` (1.170 here, right value 1.000) and harness `selfmod_independent_4kw` (0.780). Nulls: `selfmod_matched`, `true_0.7_4kw`.
- `dev/programme/carries/carry-2065.json`: to 7b, capping the floor at the observed running draw. Control: `min3_running_folded` (3/15 here). #2065 has merged, so 7b -- its observed-draw consumer -- is the live destination, and both files' `brief_lint` acceptance is 0 errors / 0 warnings at this head.
- The `6deb0603` survivor pair is **this** branch's disposition to make when the head's pins matrix reports the pair; round 8 already drove the `CMP_BOUND` arm and measured it a survivor. It is not carried to another PR's brief.
- `dev/audit/rca/`: the line-shift recurrence is owed a `root-cause.md` seat and is not this body's to write. The standing unenforced half: a body deferring a measured survivor to `mutation-autofix` is falsified by no check, because the bot never triages.
- **A finding for whoever next reads `deployment_shape.py`'s census**, already carried in the tree: the docstring's numbers are asserted by `tests/entities.py`, but the *provenance clauses* beside them are read by nothing. Round 12 is a fourth instance of the class meeting the same lucky ending: the branch's stale prose clause lost its place to main's newer prose through conflict geometry, not detection.

## Friction

- `local-drive`: cost: this host's default `python3` is 3.11 and the suite needs 3.12+ syntax, so every python figure above ran under the `venv-ci` 3.14 interpreter. The local full mutation drive still cannot complete on this box (round 11's two box bounds stand: the features-baseline red on the BLAS float -- which passed here -- and the env_drift pool-cost timeout under seat load); both lines are quoted in the round-11 body so "no refusal" and "no verdict" stay distinguishable, and CI is the authority.
- `gate-scoping.md`: cost: the scoped `closure.py select` at this head read `MODE: SCOPED -- 28 script(s) run, 5 scoped out`; the scripts in that list this host can run were run above, the heavy arms left to CI per tvofi's 2026-10-07 rule.
- `record-provenance`: stale: round 12 changed no recorded *number* falsely -- the one record the merge moved (`structure_budgets.json`) was re-taken with `--record` on the clean tree and the gate confirms it -- but the class stands: a merge can leave every recorded number true and one recorded cause false, and no instrument reads cause clauses.
- `ancestry-reds`: unenforced: the step reads the remote head, so a commit that exists only locally answers `422 No commit found`; the push order (branch first, then the body) is what prepr enforces on this push.
